name: Canva
description:
Make AI-powered social posts, videos, presentations, and more with Canva.

Launched in 2013, Canva is an online design and publishing tool with a mission to empower everyone in the world to design anything and publish anywhere.

Discover features that unlock your creativity
Design and edit like a pro on Canva. Enhance images, convert PDFs, add text to video, and more. Our slew of clever features lets you take your content to the next level — in just a few clicks.
